items.source: Typical usage is to register a variety of bean definitions via the BeanDefinitionRegistry interface and then call AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() to initialize those beans with application context semantics (handling ApplicationContextAware, auto-detecting BeanFactoryPostProcessors, etc).
items.translation: 典型用法是通过 BeanDefinitionRegistry 接口注册各种 bean 定义，然后调用 AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() 以应用上下文语义初始化这些 bean（处理 ApplicationContextAware、自动检测 BeanFactoryPostProcessors 等）。

items.source: This ApplicationContext implementation is suitable for Ahead of Time processing, using refreshForAotProcessing(RuntimeHints) as an alternative to the regular AbstractApplicationContext.refresh().
items.translation: 此 ApplicationContext 实现适用于提前处理，可使用refreshForAotProcessing(RuntimeHints)作为常规的AbstractApplicationContext.refresh()的替代方案。

items.source: In this mode, only BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor and MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor are invoked.
items.translation: 在此模式下，仅会调用 BeanDefinitionRegistryPostProcessor 和 MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessor。

items.source: NOTE: You need to call AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() to initialize the bean factory and its contained beans with application context semantics (autodetecting BeanFactoryPostProcessors, etc).
items.translation: 注意：您需要调用AbstractApplicationContext.refresh()来初始化 bean 工厂及其包含的 bean，使其具有应用上下文语义（自动检测 BeanFactoryPostProcessor 等）。

items.source: In contrast to other ApplicationContext implementations that create a new internal BeanFactory instance for each refresh, the internal BeanFactory of this context is available right from the start, to be able to register bean definitions on it. AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() may only be called once.
items.translation: 与其他为每次刷新创建新的内部 BeanFactory 实例的 ApplicationContext 实现不同，此上下文的内部 BeanFactory 从一开始即可用，以便在其上注册 bean 定义。AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() 只能调用一次。

items.source: As of Spring Framework 5.3.22, this method also honors registered protocol resolvers when a custom ResourceLoader has been set.
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 5.3.22 起，当设置了自定义 ResourceLoader 时，此方法还会尊重已注册的协议解析器。

items.source: This variant of AbstractApplicationContext.refresh() is used by Ahead of Time (AOT) processing that optimizes the application context, typically at build time.
items.translation: 此 `AbstractApplicationContext.refresh()` 变体由提前处理（Ahead of Time，AOT）使用，该处理在构建时优化应用程序上下文。

items.source: You can also pass in a full ResourcePatternResolver, which will be autodetected by the context and used for getResources calls as well. Else, default resource pattern matching will apply.
items.translation: 您也可以传入一个完整的 `ResourcePatternResolver`，它将被上下文自动检测并用于 `getResources` 调用。否则，将应用默认的资源模式匹配。

items.source: This can be used to apply encapsulated pieces of programmatic bean registration to this application context without relying on individual calls to its context-level registerBean methods.
items.translation: 这可用于将封装的程序化 Bean 注册片段应用到该应用程序上下文，而无需依赖对其上下文级registerBean方法的单独调用。

items.source:
The main reason to specify a custom ResourceLoader is to resolve
resource paths (without URL prefix) in a specific fashion.
The default behavior is to resolve such paths as class path locations.
To resolve resource paths as file system locations, specify a
FileSystemResourceLoader here.
items.translation: 指定自定义 ResourceLoader 的主要原因是以特定方式解析资源路径（不带 URL 前缀）。默认行为是将此类路径解析为类路径位置。若要作为文件系统位置解析资源路径，请在此处指定 FileSystemResourceLoader。

items.source:
The default is that ClassLoader access will happen using the thread context
class loader at the time of actual resource access.
items.translation: 默认情况下，类加载器访问将在实际资源访问时通过线程上下文类加载器进行。

items.source:

items.translation: 将传递给由该资源加载器创建的所有 ClassPathResource 对象的构造函数。
